The "Definitional" topic within the AKDB (Acute Database) corpus encompasses the precise clinical and operational definitions used to measure hospital performance and patient care quality. Accurate definitions are critical for ensuring that clinical indicators and medical classification codes are applied consistently across healthcare facilities, allowing for reliable benchmarking and quality assurance.

A primary focus of these definitions involves surgical wait times and the appropriate use of medical coding. [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] is defined as the proportion of patients who are operated on within six hours of arriving at the hospital, calculated specifically among the subset of patients who undergo surgery within 24 hours of arrival [^src1]. When tracking such metrics, the correct application of medical codes is essential; however, the SKS code [[sks-kode-naaz42|SKS-koden NAAZ42]] ('Anæstesiologisk tilsyn' or anesthesiological supervision) cannot be used for this specific measurement purpose [^src2].

Post-operative recovery is similarly governed by strict definitional criteria to ensure uniform reporting. [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]] measures the proportion of patients who are mobilized within 24 hours after their operation [^src3]. To standardize this metric across departments, mobilization is explicitly defined as the patient moving from a lying position to either a sitting or standing position, specifically requiring that the patient has physically left the bed [^src3].

## Claims
- Indikator 5 er defineret som andelen af patienter, der opereres inden for seks timer efter ankomst til sygehus for patienter, der er opereret inden for 24 timer efter ankomst til sygehus [^src1] (indikator-5)
- SKS-koden NAAZ4 'Anæstesiologisk tilsyn' ikke kan bruges til dette [^src1] (sks-kode-naaz42)
- Indikator 6 beskriver andelen af patienter, der mobiliseres indenfor 24 timer efter operation [^src1] (indikator-6)
- Mobilisering er defineret ved mobilisering fra liggende stilling til enten siddende eller stående stilling, hvor patienten har forladt sengen [^src1] (indikator-6)
